title: NaN and infinity are refused at the expression boundary
teaches: An expression result must be a finite number (or a finite numeric vector). The t=0 dry-run catches sqrt of a negative and an overflowing pow, emitting expr_result_invalid (19) for each track before any table exists.
observe: (sqrt -1) evaluates to NaN and is refused.
Both diagnostics are collected; pack exits 1 with no carrier.
A NaN never reaches the write buffer.
